name: London Project affiliate layout standard v6 - fixed reusable ten-product set
selection_principles: This v6 policy supersedes older randomized category-mix rules. Each site reuses its own fixed ten-product set until an operator manually replaces the catalog.
Each article has exactly three branded header buttons in one horizontal row: Trip.com (blue), OLIVE YOUNG (green), Coupang Partners (orange), in that order.
The header must use branded/logo-style tiles and each button must use a real verified tracking URL authorized for that destination.
Do not render the old large navy generic buttons or raw Unicode-escaped Trip.com category link rows.
All ten bottom product cards are Coupang Partners products only.
Every article reuses the same ten verified Coupang products from that site’s fixed catalog until manual replacement; do not search or rotate products per article.
Keep one site-specific fixed catalog of exactly ten verified Coupang offers, each with one unique account-generated tracking URL and one unique official product image.
Reuse the exact same ten catalog entries in the same order on every article; change the set only through a deliberate manual catalog update.
Use genuine account-generated Coupang tracking links and verified official product images. Never invent products, links, images, prices, sales, reviews or commission rates.
Keep separate product pools per destination; never share WordPress and Blogger catalogs.
Agoda remains disabled. Olive Young and Trip.com are header buttons only, not product-card providers.
Preserve editorial body, status, publication date, featured image and SEO metadata; replace only the designated affiliate block.
